spec.description:
The STINGER CN100B is a high-production pneumatic cap nailer
engineered for rapid, code-compliant installation of roofing underlayments,
roofing felt, and housewrap. Firing up to 5 cap nails per second, it
automatically feeds and drives full 25mm plastic collated caps with 25mm
ring-shank nails. Tested and approved for wind speeds up to 180 mph and
certified for IBHS FORTIFIED Roof standards, it provides maximum holding power
and seals fastener penetrations against water intrusion.
features:
Pneumatic cap nailer firing up to 5 cap nails per second for maximum jobsite
speed

High-capacity magazine holds 200 collated plastic caps and 200 coil
ring-shank nails

Drives full 25mm (1 inch) plastic caps with 25mm x 2.1mm
electro-galvanized or stainless nails

Tested and approved for severe winds up
to 180 mph and IBHS FORTIFIED Home standards

Selectable bumpfire and
sequential firing modes to suit operator workflow

Tool-free depth-of-drive
adjustment ensures caps seat perfectly flush

Lightweight 2.3 kg (4.9 lbs) ergonomic design minimizes arm
fatigue

Plastic caps seal out moisture and eliminate material pull-through or
lateral slippage

install:
Connect CN100B tool to a clean, dry, regulated compressed air
supply set between 70 and 100 psi

Open the nail canister and load a 200-nail
coil of STINGER 25mm ring-shank nails

Open the cap basket, load a 200-cap
reel of 25mm collated plastic caps, and feed into the guide track

Close and
latch both magazines securely

Select desired firing mode: bumpfire for high
production speed or sequential for single-shot precision

Position the
nosepiece perpendicular against the roof underlayment or housewrap over timber
substrate

Depress safety contact and actuate trigger to drive the cap nail
flush against the membrane

Adjust the tool-free depth-of-drive wheel so caps
seat firmly without overdriving or crushing
selection_checklist:
Confirm project requires ring-shank nail holding power (mandatory in high-wind
and coastal zones)

Ensure regulated jobsite compressed air supply (70-100
psi) is available

Choose nail coating: electro-galvanized or 304 stainless
steel NailPac based on corrosion environment

Order matching STINGER 25mm
NailPac fastener coils (#136260 or #136262)
limitations: Requires an air compressor and pneumatic hose on site

Must
only be operated with genuine STINGER 25mm NailPac fasteners

For timber
substrates only; not designed for steel framing or solid concrete
spec.warranty: 1-year limited warranty backed by National Nail Corp

retrieval.rag_summary:
The STINGER CN (CN100B) is a
high-speed pneumatic cap nailer manufactured by National Nail for securing
synthetic underlayment, roofing felt, and housewrap to timber substrates. Firing
up to 5 cap nails per second with a 200-count magazine capacity, it drives 25mm
(1 inch) plastic collated caps with 25mm ring-shank nails (loaded via STINGER
NailPac). Tested to withstand winds up to 180 mph and certified under IBHS
FORTIFIED Home standards, it prevents underlayment blow-offs and seals fastener
penetrations against water ingress.
